0022600005.text: The Lakers host the Golden State Warriors in the Lakers' first game of the 2026-27 season, and neither team has played a 2026-27 game yet. Lakers players not currently available are Adou Thiero (undisclosed), Bronny James (illness), Cameron Carr (undisclosed bruise), Collin Sexton (lower leg), and Jarred Vanderbilt (undisclosed), all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. Warriors players not currently available are Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (undisclosed), and Moses Moody (knee surgery) as out, with Brandin Podziemski (back), Charles Bassey (knee), and Stephen Curry (ankle sprain) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the Lakers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 119-103 regular-season win in San Francisco on April 9, 2026.
